what: a goblin: a small, scrawny, hunched green-skinned creature with long pointed ears, a hooked nose and yellow eyes.
colours: bright leaf-green skin, dirty brown rags.
wears: It wears only a ragged brown loincloth and scraps of cloth; no armour at all.
holds: It holds exactly one small rusty knife in its right hand. Its left hand is an open empty claw with nothing in it.
pose: It is springing forward off one foot in a low pounce, knife arm stabbing out ahead of it, its free hand clawing the air, mouth open in a shriek.

what: a goblin shaman: a small hunched green-skinned goblin whose face is hidden behind a mask cut from a big spotted mushroom cap, with long pointed ears sticking out at the sides.
colours: green skin, a red-and-white spotted mushroom-cap mask, bone-white charms, a pale yellow-green hex glow.
wears: It wears a ragged robe hung with small bones, feathers and dried mushrooms.
holds: It shakes exactly one rattle in its right hand, held high: a thick wooden stick with a cluster of big white knucklebones tied to the top. Its left hand is empty and raised, with a pale yellow-green magic glow close around the fingers.
pose: It is hopping on one foot mid-dance, rattle raised high, left hand thrust forward casting a hex.
must_show: magic glow or bone charms that say 'caster'

what: a goblin crossbowman: a small wiry green-skinned goblin ambusher with long pointed ears, one eye squinted shut to aim down an old wooden crossbow.
colours: olive-green skin, a dark brown patched hood and cloak, a plain wooden crossbow with a dark iron bow and a pale string.
wears: It wears a dark patched hood and short cloak, and a quiver of bolts on its hip.
holds: It holds exactly one old medieval crossbow in both hands, made only of wood, iron and string: a capital T made of two thick parts. The upright of the T is a plain wooden stock no longer than its arm, flat-topped, with one short bolt lying in a groove along its top. The crossbar of the T is a thick dark iron bow fixed across the front end of the stock, bent in a deep curve with both ends swept far back towards the goblin, and one pale string runs straight between the two tips of the bow, past the goblin's hands. There is nothing on top of the stock but the bolt: no tube, no sight, no barrel.
pose: It crouches low on both feet, knees bent and back hunched, both feet flat on the ground and neither knee touching it, levelling the crossbow at chest height, pointed to the left and tilted a little towards the viewer so the T shape of the weapon and both arms of the bow are plainly seen sticking out to either side of the stock.
must_show: a crossbow that reads as a crossbow: stock, crosswise bow with two arms, string
crouching on both feet, aiming (not kneeling)
must_not_show: rifle stock with a trigger guard

what: a hobgoblin soldier: a tall, broad-shouldered, upright goblinoid, a full head taller and far heavier than a goblin, with dark green skin, a flat fierce face, short pointed ears and small tusks.
colours: dark forest-green skin, blackened iron armour with dull red cloth.
wears: It wears a disciplined soldier's kit: an iron helmet, a mail shirt and iron shoulder plates over a red tabard.
holds: It holds exactly one curved sword in its right hand; its left hand is an empty clenched fist.
pose: It strides forward in a drilled fighting stance, sword drawn back for a cut, chin down.
must_show: taller and broader than a goblin, upright

what: a goblin king: an old, pot-bellied, scarred green-skinned goblin with long pointed ears and a wide shrieking mouth, small like other goblins but puffed up with stolen finery.
colours: green skin, a crown of bent copper coins, a tattered dark crimson cape with a mangy brown fur collar, gold rings.
wears: It wears a lopsided crown made of bent copper coins wired together with teeth, a tattered cape far too long for it that drags behind, and too many stolen necklaces.
holds: It holds exactly one jewelled dagger in its right hand; its left hand points forward giving an order.
pose: It stands on tiptoe with its chest puffed out, head thrown back, shrieking a command.
must_show: clearly the leader, more ornate than every other goblin

what: a skeleton: a human skeleton of bare ivory bones and nothing else, with an empty grinning skull and exposed ribs. It has the realistic anatomy and proportions of a tall adult man: a small skull, a long neck and spine, a narrow ribcage, long thin arms and legs, and it stands about eight heads tall.
colours: ivory and yellowed bone with grey-brown shadows.
wears: It wears nothing at all: no armour, no helmet, no clothes, only a few threads of rotted cloth at the hips.
holds: It holds exactly one old wooden club in its right hand; its left hand is empty.
pose: It lunges forward on one bent leg with the club swung far back over its shoulder for a blow, its free arm thrown out for balance, jaw hanging open.
must_show: bare bones, ribs and skull clearly visible
realistic adult proportions (small skull, long limbs)

what: a skeleton warrior: a human skeleton man-at-arms. Its head is a bare bone skull, and its forearms, hands, legs and feet are bare bone with no skin or flesh anywhere. It has the realistic anatomy and proportions of a tall adult man: a small skull, a long neck and spine, a narrow ribcage, long thin arms and legs, and it stands about eight heads tall.
colours: ivory bone, dark grey iron chainmail speckled with orange rust, a grey iron helmet, a plain brown wooden shield with an iron rim.
wears: It wears a knee-length shirt of rusted iron chainmail and an old dented iron kettle helmet with a wide brim. It wears no cloth tunic and no bandana.
holds: It holds exactly one notched sword in its right hand and exactly one round wooden shield on its left arm.
pose: It advances behind its raised shield in a drilled stance, sword drawn back to thrust.
must_show: skeleton (skull face, bare bone arms and legs)
one sword and one round wooden shield
realistic adult proportions (small skull, long limbs)
must_not_show: full plate armour hiding the bones

what: a skeleton archer: a human skeleton bowman with a bare skull face and exposed ribs. It has the realistic anatomy and proportions of a tall adult man: a small skull, a long neck and spine, a narrow ribcage, long thin arms and legs, and it stands about eight heads tall.
colours: ivory bone, a faded green hood, a dark wooden longbow.
wears: It wears only a tattered green hood and a quiver of arrows on its back; no armour.
holds: It draws exactly one large, thick wooden longbow with one arrow nocked: the bow upright in its left hand, the string pulled back to its jaw with the right.
pose: It stands side-on in a wide archer's stance, leaning back into the draw, aiming up and to the left.
must_show: longbow at full draw with an arrow
realistic adult proportions (small skull, long limbs)

what: a skeleton mage: the skeleton of a wizard, a bare skull under a deep hood, with bare ribs showing where its robe hangs open. It has the realistic anatomy and proportions of a tall adult man: a small skull, a long neck and spine, a narrow ribcage, long thin arms and legs, and it stands about eight heads tall.
colours: ivory bone, faded violet robes with silver trim, a pale violet magic light.
wears: It wears a tattered violet wizard's robe and hood hanging loose on bare ribs, with a spellbook chained at its belt.
holds: Its hands are empty; a pale violet light crawls between the finger bones of its raised right hand. It has no staff and no weapon.
pose: It leans forward with its right hand thrust out casting a ray, robe sleeves swept back.
must_show: skeleton (skull, ribs visible through the robe)
pale violet magic at the hand
realistic adult proportions (small skull, long limbs)

what: a burning skeleton: a human skeleton on fire, made of thick sturdy bones. Every single bone is burnt black like charcoal and split by broad glowing cracks, so that each bone is banded half charcoal-black and half bright glowing ember-orange: the skull is charred black with glowing cracks exactly like the ribs, spine, arms and legs, with no white or ivory bone anywhere. The whole skeleton is plainly visible. A crown of orange and yellow flame as tall as the skull rises from the skull, flames run along both shoulders and both forearms and wrap both hands, and the inside of the ribcage is filled with bright yellow-orange fire that shines out between the black ribs and out through the eye sockets. It has the realistic anatomy and proportions of a tall adult man: a small skull, a long neck and spine, a narrow ribcage, long arms and legs, and it stands about eight heads tall.
colours: charcoal-black bone banded with broad bright ember-orange glowing cracks on every bone including the skull, bright orange and yellow flames, bright yellow-orange fire inside the ribcage.
wears: It wears nothing; the flames are its only covering.
holds: Its hands are empty and wreathed in fire.
pose: It lunges forward with one burning hand thrust out to grab and the other drawn back, trailing fire.
must_show: every bone burnt black, the skull included
bones clearly visible (skull, ribs, limbs), not hidden in fire
flames from the skull, shoulders and hands
glow inside the ribcage and eyes
realistic adult proportions (small skull, long limbs)
broad bright glowing cracks on the arm and leg bones, so the limbs show in the small sprite
the ribcage full of bright fire
must_not_show: body hidden inside a column of fire

what: a giant rat: an ordinary rat grown to the size of a terrier, a four-legged animal with a pointed snout, round ears, long whiskers and a long bare tail.
colours: grey-brown fur, a pale belly, pink ears, feet and tail, yellow incisors.
wears: It is a plain animal and wears nothing.
holds: It is an animal on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, it scurries to the left low to the ground with its mouth open and incisors bared.
must_show: a rat on all four legs

what: a dire rat: a savage rat the size of a large dog, a heavy four-legged animal with a scarred muzzle, a torn ear, a spiky raised ridge of fur along its back and oversized fangs.
colours: dark chocolate-brown and black matted fur, red eyes, a scabby pink tail, yellow fangs.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It is an animal on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, it is leaping to the left with jaws wide open and front claws reaching.
must_show: bigger, darker and more savage than a giant rat

what: a wererat: a hunched rat-man standing upright on two legs, with a rat's head, whiskers, round ears, clawed hands and a long bare tail.
colours: dirty grey-tan fur, a patched dark brown hooded cloak, a pink tail.
wears: It wears a thief's patched hooded cloak and a belt of pouches.
holds: It holds exactly one thin dagger in its right hand, held low; its left hand is empty.
pose: It slinks forward on tiptoe in a sneaking crouch, dagger ready, tail curled, glancing sideways.
must_show: upright rat-man (rat head, two legs, tail)

what: a cave spider: a spider the size of a cat with a small round body, eight thin jointed legs and a cluster of small black eyes.
colours: dull sandy brown with darker brown leg bands.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing.
pose: Seen from slightly above, it crouches low with its legs drawn in ready to spring, front pair of legs raised.
must_show: a spider with eight thin legs
small and light next to the giant spider
nothing under it: no web, no ground

what: a giant spider: a real spider scaled up to the size of a horse, with the true body of a tarantula: a small head section, a huge round hairy abdomen behind it, and exactly eight thick hairy jointed legs, four on each side. It has a cluster of eight small red eyes and two long curved fangs.
colours: black and dark charcoal hair, red eyes, pale yellow venom dripping from the fangs.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the front and slightly above, it crouches wide and low with all eight legs spread out to the sides, the front pair lifted off the ground, fangs spread.
must_show: a true spider body (two body sections, eight legs)
much larger and heavier than a cave spider

what: a phase spider: a large real spider with the true body of a spider (a small head section, a sleek oval abdomen, and exactly eight long thin jointed legs), coloured in sharp pale blue and white bands. It is solid and clearly drawn except for the tips of its two rearmost legs and the very end of its abdomen, which thin out into a few short wisps of pale mist.
colours: pale ice-blue and white bands, cyan eyes, a pale blue mist.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the front and slightly above, it stalks forward with two front legs lifted and reaching, the other legs planted wide.
must_show: a true spider body with eight long legs, solid and clear
only the rear tips fading into a little mist
must_not_show: cloud of mist around the body

what: a spider queen: an enormous, regal spider with a vast swollen abdomen marked with a bright violet pattern, eight long armoured legs tipped with blades, a crown-like ring of spines on her head and a cluster of glowing violet eyes.
colours: glossy black body, royal violet and magenta markings, gold-tipped spines.
wears: She is an animal and wears nothing; her crown is a natural ring of spines.
holds: She holds nothing.
pose: She towers with her body raised high on all eight legs, front legs spread wide, a pale egg sac under her abdomen.
must_show: the largest and most ornate spider of the family

what: a zombie: a walking human corpse of ordinary build, with sunken eyes, a slack jaw and long filthy fingernails.
colours: sickly grey-green flesh, a dirty off-white burial shroud, dark stains.
wears: It wears a torn burial shroud hanging off one shoulder.
holds: Its hands are empty and it holds nothing.
pose: It shambles forward off balance, one arm clawing ahead, head tilted to one side.
must_show: a human corpse of ordinary size

what: a plague zombie: the walking corpse of a man from a plague pit, dead flesh and never living: gaunt and hunched, bald, with sunken blank white eyes, hollow cheeks and lips dried back from the teeth. Big round swollen black boils, each as large as his eye, stand out on his bald head, his cheeks, his neck and the backs of his hands, and his fingers are black to the knuckles.
colours: sickly pale grey-yellow dead skin, cold like a wax candle, blotched with big black boils; black fingers; a filthy very dark brown tunic, the colour of an old iron nail; dirty grey rag wrappings.
wears: He wears a medieval peasant's knee-length homespun tunic of very dark brown cloth with long torn sleeves, filthy and ragged at the hem, that covers his chest, belly, shoulders and upper arms completely, a rope belt, grey rag leg-wrappings, and a strip of dirty grey cloth tied round his jaw and over the top of his head.
holds: His hands are empty and he holds nothing.
pose: He lurches forward doubled over, jaw hanging open, both blackened hands reaching out in front of him.
must_show: a human corpse of ordinary size, plainly dead
a brown peasant tunic covering the chest and belly
big dark boils on face and arms, black fingers
visibly diseased, unlike a plain zombie in its shroud
must_not_show: glow, haze or halo round the figure

what: a giant stitched corpse: an enormous dead body sewn together from several corpses, twice the width of a man, with mismatched patches of rotting grey-green and yellowed skin joined by thick black rope stitches, a small lopsided head with one dead white eye and a slack jaw, a sagging swollen belly, and two huge club-like fists.
colours: rotting grey-green and sallow yellow dead skin in mismatched patches, black stitches, dark red open seams, rusty iron chains.
wears: It wears only a torn filthy brown sackcloth wrap at the waist and broken rusty chains hanging from its wrists.
holds: Its hands are empty; it holds nothing.
pose: It lumbers forward hunched over, dragging one foot, with both huge fists raised to hammer down.
must_show: dead rotting flesh in mismatched patches
thick black stitches across the body
enormous bulk, far bigger than a zombie

what: a troll: a tall, lanky, stooped giant with warty skin, very long arms that hang to its knees, a long drooping nose, small tusks and long hooked claws.
colours: mossy green warty skin, yellow eyes, dirty yellow claws.
wears: It wears only a ragged hide loincloth.
holds: Its clawed hands are empty and it holds nothing.
pose: It is in the middle of a huge sideways claw swipe: its body twisted at the waist, one long arm flung far across in front of it with claws spread, the other trailing behind, one foot off the ground, mouth roaring.
must_show: tall lanky giant with very long arms

what: an ice troll: a tall, lanky, stooped giant with very long arms, a long nose and tusks, its skin pale blue-white like glacier ice, with a shaggy white mane, icicles hanging from its chin and elbows, and claws of clear ice.
colours: pale ice-blue and white skin, white fur, cyan ice claws, frosty breath.
wears: It wears only a white fur loincloth.
holds: Its clawed hands are empty and it holds nothing.
pose: It lunges forward raking with one frozen claw, breath steaming in a white cloud.
must_show: troll build (tall, lanky, long arms, long nose)

what: a cave troll: a massive, heavy-set giant, much bulkier than an ordinary troll, with a thick ridged hide like cracked grey rock, long powerful arms, a long nose, big tusks and pale blind-looking eyes.
colours: slate-grey and cold stone-grey ridged hide like cracked rock, pale eyes, a rough grey boulder.
wears: It wears only a rough hide loincloth.
holds: It holds exactly one large boulder lifted over its head in both hands, about to throw it.
pose: It leans back with the boulder hoisted overhead in both hands, roaring.
must_show: troll build with long arms and long nose
heavier and bulkier than a troll

what: a kobold: a very small, skinny reptilian creature like a little upright lizard, with a long snout full of small teeth, small backswept horns, big yellow eyes and a thin tail.
colours: rust-orange and tan scales, a pale belly, dirty brown rags.
wears: It wears a ragged miner's loincloth and a little candle-stub strapped to its head.
holds: It holds exactly one short spear in both hands.
pose: It jabs the short spear forward in a nervous crouch, tail up for balance.
must_show: small upright lizard-like creature with snout, horns and tail

what: a kobold trapsetter: a very small, skinny reptilian creature like a little upright lizard, with a long snout, small backswept horns, sly narrowed yellow eyes and a thin tail.
colours: rust-orange and tan scales, dark leather straps, grey iron darts.
wears: It wears a leather bandolier of barbed darts across its chest and a coil of tripwire over one shoulder.
holds: It holds exactly one iron bear-trap in its left hand, carried open by its chain: two curved iron jaws lined with big triangular teeth, like an open mouth. In its right hand it holds exactly one barbed dart, drawn back to throw.
pose: It twists side-on, right arm cocked back to throw the dart, grinning.
must_show: an iron jaw-trap in the left hand
one dart ready to throw in the right hand

what: a kobold sorcerer: a very small reptilian creature like a little upright lizard, with a long snout, a tall proud crest of horns like a tiny dragon, glowing orange eyes and a thin tail.
colours: bright crimson-red scales, a gold necklace, orange and yellow fire.
wears: It wears a scrap of gold-trimmed red cloth as a mantle and a necklace of gold coins, like tiny royalty.
holds: Its hands are empty; a ball of orange fire burns in its raised right palm, touching the hand. It has no staff and no weapon.
pose: It stands tall and haughty with its right hand raised hurling the fire, chin lifted.
must_show: red scales, unlike the orange-tan common kobold
dragon-like crest and gold: the tribe's royalty

what: a minotaur: a huge, heavily muscled man standing upright on two human legs, with the head of a bull: a broad bull's muzzle, a brass nose ring and long curved horns. A thick shaggy mane of very dark brown bull's hair covers his whole head, his neck, both shoulders, his upper back and his chest; only his forearms, belly and thighs are bare skin.
colours: very dark brown, nearly black, shaggy hair on the head, neck, shoulders, chest and upper back; weather-beaten light tan skin on the forearms, belly and thighs; ivory horns; a dark leather kilt and harness with dull bronze studs.
wears: He wears a bronze-studded leather harness across his chest and a leather war-kilt.
holds: His hands are empty clenched fists and he holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing the left edge of the picture. He is charging: running at full tilt upright on his two human legs, body pitched far forward, head down with the horns aimed ahead to the left, one knee driving up, both arms pumping with the fists clenched, hair and kilt streaming back.
must_show: upright on two legs with a man's body
dark brown shaggy mane over head, shoulders and chest
seen from the side, running left, horns lowered

what: a lich: a tall, gaunt undead sorcerer-king, a bare skull with cold blue fire in the eye sockets and skeletal hands, wrapped in grand but rotting robes. It has the realistic anatomy and proportions of a tall adult man: a small skull, a long neck and spine, a narrow ribcage, long thin arms and legs, and it stands about eight heads tall.
colours: ivory bone, deep midnight-blue robes with tarnished gold embroidery, a tarnished gold crown, cold blue magic.
wears: He wears long tattered royal robes with a high collar, a tarnished gold crown and a jewelled amulet on a chain at his chest.
holds: His hands are empty; crackling cold-blue magic gathers around his outstretched right hand. He has no staff and no weapon.
pose: He floats just off the ground with robes billowing, right hand thrust forward casting, left hand curled like a claw.
must_show: skull face with blue fire eyes
cold blue magic at an empty hand
far more regal and powerful than a skeleton mage
realistic adult proportions (small skull, long limbs)

what: a wraith: a torn hooded shroud of soot-black cloth hanging in the air with nothing inside it. The hood is empty: inside it is only pitch darkness and two cold eye lights, which are the two brightest things in the picture, each as long as a quarter of the hood is wide, slanted, with no pupils. Two long ragged sleeves reach forward, and out of each sleeve comes one long thin hand of pale bone-white claws, each finger as long as the hood is tall, plainly seen against the backdrop. Below the chest the shroud narrows into one long ragged tapering tail of torn cloth that streams back behind it, joined to the body. The cloth is coal-black in the folds and dark slate-grey on the ridges, with one thin bright line of pale icy blue light along its outer edge.
colours: coal-black and dark slate-grey cloth, one thin pale icy-blue line of light along its edges, two bright icy blue-white eye lights, pale bone-white claws.
wears: It is nothing but an empty tattered hooded shroud.
holds: Its two pale clawed hands are empty and spread wide; it holds nothing.
pose: It swoops diagonally down to the left, hood first, both pale clawed hands reaching out ahead of it with the fingers spread, the ragged tail of the shroud streaming up behind it to the upper right. Empty air all round it and nothing beneath it.
must_show: empty hood with two pale eye lights
two bright eye lights in a black hood, clear in the small sprite
pale bone-white claws clear of the body
the shroud ends in one ragged tail
must_not_show: a man's body under the cloth
